title: correction_proposal
description: A proposed fix for a confirmed deviation. Reviewed by a human before anything is applied.

target.description: What gets edited. Must follow from the root cause: agent -> prompt, data -> mapping, sow -> sow. Use human when no edit fixes it and a person must act.

title.description: Short imperative name for the change, e.g. 'Add a tool-failure guard to the agent prompt'.

rationale.description: One or two sentences on why this change prevents recurrence.

beforeText.description: The current text or mapping being replaced, quoted exactly as it exists today. Empty string if nothing exists yet.

afterText.description: The proposed replacement, complete and ready to apply — not a description of what to write.

scope.description: Which sites or behaviours this change affects.

cmmsAction.description: The CMMS write needed to repair the real-world consequence, when there is one. Omitted fields mean no write is proposed.

verb.description: none when the correction is purely a prompt, mapping or clause edit with no record to repair.

why.description: Why this record write is needed, in one sentence.

recordId.description: The existing service request id to update. Empty string when verb is create or none.

fields.description: The fields to write, as label/value pairs.

isChange.description: True when this field is being changed from an existing value rather than set for the first time.

humanAction.description: The task for a person, when needsHuman was true.

action.description: What the person must do, specific enough to act on without reading the call.

assigneeRole.description: The role that should own it, e.g. 'Helpdesk supervisor' or 'Duty manager'.
